talk.jaymoskingdoms.menace.wary.2: Easy now. There's no one here you need to cut.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.menace.wary.3: Why are you crouched over that steel like that? Stay back.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.menace.wary.4: I want no trouble. Keep it away from me.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.menace.child.1: Mama! They've got a sword out!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.menace.warn.1: Halt. Sheathe that blade, or I take it for a threat.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.menace.warn.2: You. Stand easy and put that steel away. This is your warning.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.menace.warn.3: Crouched with a drawn blade among peaceful folk? Sheathe it. Now.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.menace.set_on.1: I warned you! Guards, to me!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.menace.set_on.2: You'd not sheathe it. Then you're for the steel yourself!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.menace.set_on.3: A threat to this place, then. Take them!
message.jaymoskingdoms.followers.underwa: %s can't leave the ship while she's underway.
message.jaymoskingdoms.followers.no_bond: %s won't follow you or stay on your word. Only family, hired help or a friend of %s hearts will.
